category: Dashboard, messages & events and string blocks
description: Interactive Dashboard controls and displays that tune parameters and show signals during simulation, the Messages & Events library for message-based (queued, event-driven) communication, and the String library for string signals and text processing.

tools.name: Knob
tools.description: Dashboard control that tunes a connected block parameter or variable with a rotary dial while the simulation runs. Connect it in connect mode (pause on the block, click Connect, select a block and parameter) or programmatically through its Binding parameter.

parameters.name: Binding
parameters.description: Simulink.HMI.ParamSourceInfo object naming the block path and ParamName (or variable) to control.

parameters.name: Limits
parameters.description: [min tickInterval max], default [0 -1 100] where -1 means automatic ticks.

tools.notes: Dashboard blocks are ignored by code generation and do not work inside referenced models. The connected parameter must be tunable.

tools.name: Slider
tools.description: Dashboard control that tunes a connected parameter or variable with a linear sliding scale during simulation. It is the linear-scale counterpart of Knob.
tools.notes: Resize the block to switch between horizontal and vertical orientation.

tools.name: Toggle Switch
tools.description: Dashboard control that toggles a connected parameter or variable between two values. Each of the two states has a Value and a Label.
tools.usage: Simulink > Dashboard > Toggle Switch  |  add_block('simulink/Dashboard/Toggle Switch', [mdl '/Enable'])

parameters.name: States
parameters.description: 2-by-1 struct array with fields Value and Label, e.g. -5/'Reverse' and 5/'Forward'.

tools.notes: Rocker Switch and Slider Switch behave identically and differ only in appearance.

tools.name: Rocker Switch
tools.description: Two-state dashboard switch styled as a rocker that sets a connected parameter to one of two values. Use it for on/off or mode selections on a dashboard panel.
tools.notes: Clicking the switch during simulation writes the value immediately; the change is recorded in the Simulation Data Inspector.

tools.name: Slider Switch
tools.description: Two-state dashboard switch with a sliding appearance that toggles a connected parameter between two values.
tools.notes: For more than two states use Rotary Switch, Radio Button or Combo Box.

tools.name: Rotary Switch
tools.description: Dashboard control that sets a connected parameter to one of several discrete values arranged around a dial. Suitable for selecting operating modes or test cases during a run.

parameters.name: States
parameters.description: Struct array of Value/Label pairs, one per dial position.

tools.notes: The Customizable Blocks library also offers a Rotary Switch with a custom background and needle images.

tools.name: Push Button
tools.description: Dashboard button that writes its On Value to a connected parameter or variable while pressed (Momentary) or until pressed again (Latch). Use it to inject faults, trigger events or step inputs interactively.
tools.notes: When released, the parameter returns to its value from before the press.

tools.name: Callback Button
tools.description: Dashboard button that runs MATLAB code when clicked or while held, before, during or after simulation. Use it to start or stop a run, load data, or open plots directly from the canvas.

parameters.name: ClickFcn
parameters.description: MATLAB code executed on release of a click.

parameters.name: PressFcn
parameters.description: MATLAB code executed while the button is held.

parameters.name: PressDelay / RepeatInterval
parameters.description: Hold time in ms before PressFcn runs (default 500) and repeat interval (0 = once).

tools.notes: Callback code runs in the base workspace. It does not connect to parameters or signals.

tools.name: Check Box
tools.description: Dashboard control that switches a connected parameter or variable between a checked and an unchecked value. Handy for enabling optional features such as noise or logging flags.

parameters.name: Checked / Unchecked value
parameters.description: Values written for the two states (defaults 1 and 0).

tools.notes: Connect before simulation; the checked state at start is applied to the parameter.

tools.name: Combo Box
tools.description: Dashboard drop-down menu that sets a connected parameter to one of several labelled values. States can also be defined from an enumeration class.

parameters.name: States
parameters.description: Struct array of Value/Label pairs (default three states 0-2).

parameters.name: Enumerated data type
parameters.description: Use an enumeration class to populate values and labels.

tools.notes: Cannot connect to parameters inside referenced models; update the diagram (Ctrl+D) before connecting to variables.

tools.name: Radio Button
tools.description: Dashboard group of radio buttons that sets a connected parameter to the value of the selected option. Equivalent to Combo Box but with all options visible.
tools.notes: The Customizable Blocks library contains a Radio Button with custom appearance.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Dashboard edit box for typing a new value for a connected parameter during simulation. It gives precise numeric entry where knobs and sliders are too coarse.

parameters.name: Binding
parameters.description: Connected parameter or variable (scalar, or an element of a matrix/struct).

tools.notes: Not supported in rapid accelerator mode or in referenced models. An Edit (Customizable) variant exists in the Customizable Blocks library.

tools.name: Gauge
tools.description: Dashboard display showing the value of a connected signal on a circular scale with a needle. Scale colors can highlight nominal, warning and danger ranges.

parameters.name: Binding
parameters.description: Simulink.HMI.SignalSpecification identifying the signal (block path and output port).

tools.notes: Displays real scalar signals only; out-of-range values park the needle just beyond the scale.

tools.name: Half Gauge
tools.description: Dashboard display showing a connected signal on a semicircular scale. Same configuration as Gauge in a more compact footprint.
tools.notes: Like all dashboard displays, it is not included in generated code.

tools.name: Quarter Gauge
tools.description: Dashboard display showing a connected signal on a quarter-circle (quadrant) scale.
tools.notes: Useful for corner placement on dense dashboard panels.

tools.name: Linear Gauge
tools.description: Dashboard display showing a connected signal on a linear (bar) scale, horizontal or vertical depending on block shape.
tools.notes: Resize the block to change orientation.

tools.name: Lamp
tools.description: Dashboard indicator that shows a color associated with the current value of a connected signal, like a status LED. Map specific values to colors with state-color pairs.

parameters.name: StateColors
parameters.description: Struct array with fields Value and Color ([r g b], 0-1).

parameters.name: ColorDefault
parameters.description: Color for undefined values (default light grey).

tools.notes: Connect to Boolean or enumerated signals for clean state displays.

tools.name: MultiStateImage
tools.description: Dashboard display that shows a different image for each value (state) of a connected signal, for example valve open/closed pictures. A default image is shown for values without a mapping.

parameters.name: States
parameters.description: Struct array pairing states with images.

tools.notes: Supports Boolean, numeric, fixed-point and enumerated signals; ignored by code generation.

tools.name: Send
tools.description: Converts the value of an input signal into a message and sends it on a message line. Messages carry data and are consumed by Receive, Queue, Message Triggered Subsystem, Stateflow charts or SimEvents blocks, enabling event-driven, queued communication.
tools.usage: Simulink > Messages & Events > Send  |  add_block('simulink/Messages & Events/Send', [mdl '/Send'])

parameters.name: ShowEnablePort
parameters.description: 'on' adds an enable input; a message is sent only when it is > 0. With 'off' a message is sent every sample.

tools.notes: Message lines are drawn dashed. Animate and inspect traffic with the Sequence Viewer. Sent messages have constant priority 20 in SimEvents contexts.

tools.name: Receive
tools.description: Extracts the data payload from incoming messages and outputs it as a regular signal. When no new message arrives it holds the last value or outputs an initial value, and it can optionally use an internal queue and output a receive-status flag.

parameters.name: UseInternalQueue
parameters.description: 'on' gives the block its own queue ('off' by default in Simulink).

parameters.name: QueueLength / QueueType / QueueOverwriting
parameters.description: Internal queue capacity (default 16), 'FIFO'/'LIFO'/'Priority', and overwrite-oldest policy.

parameters.name: ShowQueueStatus
parameters.description: 'on' outputs a Boolean that is true when a message was received.

tools.notes: Receive is also used inside referenced models at root Inports configured for messages.

tools.name: Queue
tools.description: Stores messages (or SimEvents entities) and releases the head element when the downstream block can accept it. Supports FIFO, LIFO and priority ordering, a finite capacity and optional statistics outputs.

parameters.name: QueueOverwriting
parameters.description: 'on' overwrites the oldest message when full (Simulink default).

tools.notes: Shared with SimEvents; with SimEvents installed, entity-specific options such as Multicast arrival become available.

tools.name: Message Merge
tools.description: Combines several message lines into one message line, forwarding every message from any input to a single destination such as a Queue or a message-consuming chart.

parameters.name: NumberInputPorts
parameters.description: Number of message inputs to combine (default '2').

tools.notes: Introduced in R2021a. Unlike the signal Merge block, every incoming message is forwarded. Not supported for code generation in AUTOSAR mode.

tools.name: Sequence Viewer
tools.description: Displays messages, events, function calls, state changes and transitions between lifelines (subsystems, referenced models, charts) as a sequence diagram over time. Use it to debug message-based or function-call architectures.
tools.usage: Simulink > Messages & Events > Sequence Viewer (also in Stateflow, Simulink Test and SimEvents libraries)

parameters.name: VariableStepTimePrecision
parameters.description: Digits of time precision for variable-step solvers (default 3).

parameters.name: History
parameters.description: Maximum number of past events displayed (default 5000).

tools.notes: The Sequence Viewer can also be opened without a block from the Simulation tab when the model contains messages, Simulink Functions or Stateflow charts.

tools.name: String Constant
tools.description: Outputs a constant string signal. Use it as a source of labels, messages or format fields for the other String blocks.
tools.usage: Simulink > String > String Constant  |  add_block('simulink/String/String Constant', [mdl '/Str'])

parameters.name: String
parameters.description: MATLAB expression of the string, entered with double quotes, e.g. "Hello!".

parameters.name: OutDataTypeStr
parameters.description: 'string' (dynamic length) or stringtype(N) for a bounded maximum length.

tools.notes: Use bounded stringtype(N) for embedded code generation to avoid dynamic memory.

tools.name: String Concatenate
tools.description: Concatenates its input strings, in port order, into one output string. Supports 2 to 512 inputs.
tools.notes: Output is truncated if it exceeds a bounded output length.

tools.name: Compose String
tools.description: Builds an output string from several numeric and string inputs according to a printf-style Format, one operator per input. It is the block counterpart of sprintf.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Format specification, default '%d %f'; supports %d %i %u %o %x %X %f %e %E %g %G %s with flags, width and precision.

tools.notes: The number of input ports follows from the number of format operators.

tools.name: Scan String
tools.description: Parses an input string into numeric or string output signals according to a format, like sscanf. Use it to decode text messages or serial protocol strings.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Format specification with one operator per output, e.g. '%d,%f'.

tools.notes: Output port count equals the number of conversion operators.

tools.name: String Compare
tools.description: Compares two input strings and outputs true when they match, optionally ignoring case or comparing only the first N characters.

parameters.name: Number of characters
parameters.description: N when comparing only the first N characters.

tools.notes: Output is Boolean.

tools.name: String Contains
tools.description: Outputs true if a string contains, starts with or ends with a pattern string. Inputs are the string (str) and the pattern (sub).
tools.notes: Introduced in R2020a.

tools.name: String Count
tools.description: Counts the occurrences of a pattern string (sub) in an input string (str) and outputs the count as an integer.

parameters.name: OutDataTypeStr
parameters.description: Integer output type, default 'Inherit: Inherit via internal rule'.

tools.notes: Introduced in R2020a.

tools.name: String Find
tools.description: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a pattern (sub) in a string (str), or -1 if it is not found.

parameters.name: OutDataTypeStr
parameters.description: Index output type: inherited, int8, int16 or int32.

tools.example:
add_block('simulink/String/String Find', [mdl '/Pos']);
% feed Pos into Substring to split a message at a delimiter
tools.notes: Indexing is one-based; an empty pattern returns 1.

tools.name: String Length
tools.description: Outputs the number of characters in the input string.

parameters.name: OutDataTypeStr
parameters.description: Integer output type, default 'Inherit: Inherit via internal rule'.

tools.notes: Combine with Substring and String Find for parsing.

tools.name: Substring
tools.description: Extracts part of an input string starting at index idx for len characters, or from idx to the end.
tools.usage: Simulink > String > Substring (inputs: str, idx, len)

parameters.name: StringFromIdxToEnd
parameters.description: 'on' removes the len input and extracts to the end of the string.

parameters.name: InheritMaximumLength
parameters.description: 'on' (default) inherits the maximum output length from the input.

tools.notes: Index is one-based.

tools.name: To String
tools.description: Converts a Boolean, numeric, fixed-point or enumerated input to a string signal, e.g. 1 to "true" or an enum value to its name.
tools.notes: High-precision values may be rounded in the string; use Compose String for explicit formatting.

tools.name: String to Double
tools.description: Converts a string signal containing a numeric representation into a double signal, like str2double.
tools.notes: Use String to Single for single-precision targets.

tools.name: String to Single
tools.description: Converts a string signal to a single-precision numeric signal.
tools.notes: Preferred on hardware without double-precision floating point.

tools.name: String to Enum
tools.description: Converts a string signal to the enumeration value with the matching name, e.g. "Red" to Colors.Red.
tools.notes: The enumeration class must be on the path or defined with Simulink.defineIntEnumType.

tools.name: String to ASCII
tools.description: Converts a string signal into a uint8 vector of character codes, e.g. for transmitting text over a byte-oriented interface.

parameters.name: OutputVectorSize
parameters.description: Length of the uint8 output vector (default '31'); unused elements are zero-filled.

tools.notes: Inverse of ASCII to String.

tools.name: ASCII to String
tools.description: Converts a uint8 vector of character codes into a string signal, for example bytes received from a serial port.

parameters.name: Buffer size of dynamically-sized string (bytes)
parameters.description: Buffer used in generated code (default 256); longer inputs are truncated to buffer size - 1.

tools.notes: Inverse of String to ASCII; e.g. [72 101 108 108 111] becomes "Hello".

tools.name: stringtype
tools.description: Creates a string data type with a maximum length, returned as a Simulink.StringType object, for use as a block output data type or in bus elements and data objects. Bounded strings generate fixed-size character arrays in code.
tools.notes: A plain 'string' data type is dynamically sized, which some embedded targets do not support.
